C0833.title: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology Launches Weak Password Self-Inspection Campaign
keywords: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology
C0833.summary: In June 2026, the Information Office of the University of Shanghai for Science and Technology issued a notice requiring a university-wide inspection of information systems and websites for weak passwords. The use of weak passwords such as admin, password, and 123456 is prohibited. The initiative also promotes security awareness to prevent issues like plaintext password storage and account sharing.

references.title: Notice on Conducting a Special Self-Inspection and Rectification of 'Weak Passwords'
